statement: The canonical Production rough-cut path remains human NLE assembly. This contract makes its inputs deterministic; it does not authorize Draft Assembly evidence in Production.
authoritative_inputs: presenter-editor-handoff v2 with ASSEMBLY_ELIGIBLE selected HUMAN segments
exact approved Visual Plan V2 identity/digest
human performance review bound to every selected master SHA-256
exact HUMAN_CONFIRMED or CAPTURE_EVENT_BOUND section intervals in integer milliseconds
explicit timeline/edit plan identity and digest
forbidden_inputs: a historical KEEP ALL review used as boundary approval
evidence_may_claim: the exact selected human source intervals were consumed
the output bytes decode and match their recorded SHA-256
the output is bound to the declared Story, Visual Plan, sources, inserts, music, timeline and toolchain

may: implement or operate the technical assembly lane against exact eligible inputs
emit a hash-bound candidate and technical evidence
present the candidate for Mikko review

human_gate: Mikko confirms boundaries and selections before assembly eligibility, then separately reviews the Production assembly candidate. KEEP ALL performance review is not final-edit approval.

sequence: validate exact release packet, V2 human review, Story, VP2, source hashes, crops, inserts and human-authorized music policy
acquire an owner-identity render lock and conservatively recover only a provably dead stable holder
persist a digest-bound deterministic render plan
render only to a plan-specific partial path
run stream, cadence, frame-count, duration, source-coverage, insert and full-decode machine QC
emit renderer manifest and non-gating technical evidence
move the candidate into place and write the COMPLETE marker last
deterministic_renderer_closure.completion_authority: A candidate without the matching .complete.json marker is incomplete even if MP4 bytes exist.
deterministic_renderer_closure.recovery: Retry the identical spec and plan; an exact QC-valid staged render may resume at attestation/finalization, exact completed output is reused, and conflicting or changing output fails closed.
deterministic_renderer_closure.overwrite_policy: A COMPLETE candidate is immutable. The identical plan reuses it; a different plan requires a new output/candidate identity.
deterministic_renderer_closure.independent_qc: Hermes/QC remains a separate attester after renderer closure; renderer evidence does not replace independent QC or human review.
deterministic_renderer_closure.music_authority: Music policy uses an append-only digest-bound succession chain. The latest sole ACTIVE decision must be HUMAN and agree with the release packet; AGENT_DEFAULT may remain historical but is not durable creative authority.

performance_roles.HUMAN_DRAFT_PERFORMANCE: May consume selected PROOF_CAPTURE or PRODUCTION_CAPTURE sources; output remains a human draft candidate.
performance_roles.FINAL_HUMAN_PERFORMANCE: Requires selected PRODUCTION_CAPTURE sources; renderer success still does not confer final creative or gate approval.
